title: CircuitAgent Netlist & Circuit Specification
description: Standardized schema for the CircuitBlocks intermediate representation (IR), connecting prompt synthesizers with EDA routing compilers. The canonical shape emitted by `synthesize_from_prompt` nests connections under `netlist`; a flat shape with root-level `connections` is also accepted for hand-authored input.

prompt.description: Human natural-language prompt or intent description that generated this specification.

board.description: Physical board constraints and PCB layer configuration.

layers.description: Number of copper layers (e.g. 2 for basic boards, 4 for JLC04161H impedance-controlled boards).

modules.description: Key-value dictionary mapping component reference designators to their electrical specifications.

kind.description: Component electrical class or architectural block type.

value.description: Component nominal value or part model (e.g. 10k, 100nF, AMS1117-3.3, BLUE).

package.description: Standardized EDA footprint / package identifier (e.g. R0603, C0603, SOT-223, QFN-32_EP).

lcsc.description: LCSC / JLCPCB Part Number prefix with C followed by digits (e.g. C25804, C6186).

designator.description: Explicit reference designator (e.g. U1, R1, C1, J1).

block_names.description: CircuitBlocks that the synthesizer selected for this design.

unmatched.description: Features the caller requested that this DSL cannot build yet. An actionable capability signal.

not_requested.description: Optional blocks the prompt did not mention. Informational only — not a capability gap.

netlist.description: Nested netlist container — the canonical shape produced by the synthesizer.

modules.description: Optional duplicate of the root-level modules map, carried for consumers that read the netlist standalone.

connections.description: Complete netlist connections across physical pins and signals.

class.description: Netclass governing trace width, clearance, and routing constraints.

points.description: Component pin endpoints participating in this electrical node.

items.description: Physical component endpoint in DESIGNATOR.PIN format (e.g. U1.1, J_USB1.VBUS).
